definitions.luminance: BT.709 Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B on the evaluation-resolution RGB image
definitions.low_luminance: Ground-truth Fire pixel with Y <= threshold
definitions.smoke_proximity_proxy: Ground-truth Fire pixel within the configured radius of a ground-truth Smoke pixel
definitions.exact_overlap_note: The three-class mask is mutually exclusive, so a pixel cannot be both Smoke and Fire; exact overlap is structurally zero.

worst_selection: Lowest saved per-image Fire IoU among validation images containing at least one ground-truth Fire pixel; ties use Fire recall then filename.
